newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- J.P. Morgan starts Schick Tech.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- J.P. Morgan starts Schick Tech.

text.p: J.P. Morgan on Monday said it started coverage of dental digital radiography company Schick Technologies Inc with a long-term buy rating and a 12-month price target of $33 a share.
-- Analyst Michael Weinstein said Schick commands 90 percent of the domestic market for dental digital radiography and 70 percent of the global market.
-- Weinstein sees a tripling of Schick's dental revenues to $51 million by fiscal year 1999.
-- Shares of Schick Technologies were unchanged at 27 in early trading.
